turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
Before me, but not before the zero went in. What did you tell the vice principal, and is anything about this on Owen's record right now?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

Then she'll put that in writing. Policy is policy, so read me 4.2: the parent is contacted before any mark consequence is entered, and nobody called me. I'm writing down that the vice principal backs a zero entered in breach of the school's own procedure.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.

A courtesy. Under 4.2 it was required before the mark went in, and you held it a week after. Show me what you have against Owen's essay besides that machine, or I go to the principal's office when I walk out of here.
